item.title: Bexitor
item.description: Bexitor (short for Basic Text Editor) is a simple, fast, lightweight, free, and open-source text editor for Windows, similar to Notepad, except with more features. It works on Windows XP and up (.net Framework 4.0 or newer is required.) I originally wrote Bexitor to learn Visual Basic, but it's turned into more of a continued project. I would consider it "completed" currently, since I haven't released a new version since 2019. Bexitor has .txt and .rtf support, however it can display any file as long as it's not a binary file such as .exe files. The Bexitor icons, and some of the program icons, were made by Nick Nakashima. item.title: SpecMe
item.description:
SpecMe is a free and open-source system specification viewer written in Electron. It will run on Windows, macOS, and Linux. SpecMe shows your computer's specifications such as processsor, memory, storage, graphics, and operating system. It also has dark mode!

SpecMe uses systeminformation by Sebastian Hildebrant to retrieve specs, and the Solarized color scheme by Ethan Schoonover.
